anomalies.observed: The EPD driver capacitor C5 is specified in the netlist as 4.7uF/25V.
anomalies.expected: The design specification states that C5 is one of the default EPD driver capacitors and should be 1 uF/25 V.

evidence.quote: C2 default: 1 µF/25 V | C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V

anomalies.impact: A 4.7x larger capacitor in the EPD boost/charge-pump path can change the charge-pump timing and voltage generation, potentially causing display refresh problems or incorrect panel voltages.
